cards.meaning: a formal decision or ruling — especially one issued by a court, panel, or institution
cards.example: Maghahain ng pasya ang Senado sa Setyembre 23 hinggil sa tamang bilang ng boto.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate will issue a ruling on September 23rd on the correct vote count.
cards.note: More formal than the everyday 'desisyon' — using 'pasya' signals real institutional weight and consequence, typical of a court, Senate, or official body's ruling rather than a personal choice.
cards.tiesTo: Senate impeachment court's September 23 vote on the two-thirds conviction-threshold interpretation

cards.meaning: a deliberate step or measure taken in response to a situation — literally 'footstep,' figuratively an official action
cards.example: Posibleng maglabas ang Bangko Sentral ng bagong hakbang na off-cycle rate hike para protektahan ang piso.
cards.exampleMeaning: The BSP may issue a new off-cycle rate hike measure to protect the peso.
cards.note: Carries more deliberateness than the borrowed word 'aksyon' — 'hakbang' implies a considered, purposeful move by an institution, commonly used for a government or central-bank measure.
cards.tiesTo: BSP considering an off-cycle rate hike to defend the peso and cap imported inflation

cards.meaning: to shrink / contract — a formal, written-register verb for something losing size or strength over time (an economy, a market, investment)
cards.note: 书面语/formal register — belongs almost entirely to written or formal spoken contexts like an economic bulletin; casual speech would use 变小了 or 不行了 instead.
cards.tiesTo: China's real-estate investment falling 19.9% y/y Jan-Aug even as new-home price declines narrow

cards.meaning: although … but — an advanced connective pair for holding two contrasting facts in one sentence without letting either cancel the other out
cards.example: 虽然房价降幅收窄，但是投资和新开工降幅进一步扩大。
cards.examplePinyin: Suīrán fángjià jiàngfú shōuzhǎi, dànshì tóuzī hé xīn kāigōng jiàngfú jìnyíbù kuòdà.
cards.exampleMeaning: Although the price decline narrowed, investment and new-construction declines widened further.
cards.note: More formal and clearly structured than the everyday 不过 — the kind of connective that opens a contrast in a formal analysis rather than a loosely-tacked-on casual aside.
cards.tiesTo: China's August property data: narrowing home-price declines vs. deepening investment/construction collapse
